_comment: Stage-1 4ch VAE training on the CONSTRUCTED spatial dataset = 200k total: (a) 140k synthesized FOA from build_spatial_dataset.py (audio 80k + music 60k via pyroom; sources AudioCaps/AudioSet/MusicCaps/PicoAudio/VGGSound) + (b) 60k REAL Spatial LibriSpeech FOA used DIRECTLY (no downmix, no re-spatialization, no mixing -- it is the speech category). max_files=60000 is a deterministic SLS subsample (same 60k as the pre-encode config). No mrsdrama / mrsaudio / sphere360 / fsdkaggle.
